headline: Chennai’s nights are warming, in the city and the countryside alike
summary: Night warming is region-wide: city and farmland both, and Terra and Aqua agree on the direction at every point.
verdict: The ground stays warmer at night at all four Chennai points, from +0.38 to +0.69 °C per decade over 2000–2025, and all four are strong. All three farmland controls warmed too, from +0.27 to +0.57 °C per decade, so the gap between city and countryside shows no clear trend. That gap is a lead, not a finding.

evidence_notes.night_lst_chennai_core: The heart of the city is holding more heat at night than it used to.
evidence_notes.night_lst_chennai_omr: The IT corridor shows the fastest night warming of the four city points.
evidence_notes.night_lst_chennai_tambaram: The southern suburb is warming at night too, clearly and steadily.
evidence_notes.night_lst_chennai_avadi: The western suburb is warming at night, though the two satellites disagree on how fast.
evidence_notes.night_lst_chengalpattu_edge: We picked this spot as farmland, but the satellite classes it as built-up in both 2001 and 2024, so it is shown as an urban edge, never as a control.
evidence_notes.night_lst_rural_kanchipuram_west: Farmland far from the city is warming at night as well.
evidence_notes.night_lst_rural_uthiramerur_south: This farmland control warmed at night about as fast as the city points.
evidence_notes.night_lst_rural_uthukottai_north: The mildest warming of the three farmland controls, but still clear enough to pass the multiple-test check.
evidence_notes.uhi_chennai_core: The city centre’s lead over the farmland has barely moved.
evidence_notes.uhi_chennai_omr: The IT corridor’s lead over the farmland may be growing, but not clearly enough to call.
evidence_notes.uhi_chennai_tambaram: Tambaram’s lead over the farmland shows no clear change.
evidence_notes.uhi_chennai_avadi: Avadi’s lead over the farmland shows no clear change.

devils_advocate: Land surface temperature ≠ air temperature. These satellites measure how hot the ground is, not the air a weather station or a person feels. Each point is one 1 km pixel, and at three points Terra and Aqua agree on the direction but not the size, including two of the farmland controls.
devils_advocate_note: Terra’s overpass has also drifted earlier since about 2020; the Aqua cross-check is there to catch that. We keep this objection on the record.
can_say: The ground stays warmer at night across the Chennai region, city and farmland alike, and both satellites see it rising.
what_data_cannot_tell_us: Whether the city is warming faster than the countryside: the city-minus-farmland gaps show no clear trend yet.
would_change_it: More farmland controls, or a longer record, to tell a growing heat island apart from warming across the whole region.
next_witness: Air temperature from weather stations, to check the ground-heat trend against what people actually feel.
sources: MODIS MOD11A2 v6.1 (Terra land surface temperature, 8-day, 1 km)
MODIS MYD11A2 v6.1 (Aqua land surface temperature, 8-day, 1 km)
MODIS MCD12Q1 v6.1 (Terra+Aqua land cover type, yearly, 500 m)
